LESSON: NUTRITION IN PLANTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living things and their Environment
Topic 2.1: Nutrition in Plants

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Nutrition in Plants. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Nutrition in Plants
2. Practise Nutrition in Plants at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Nutrition in Plants

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Nutrition in Plants
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Nutrition in Plants. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Nutrition in Plants at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Nutrition in Plants at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Nutrition in Plants
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Nutrition in Plants. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Nutrition in Plants using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Nutrition in Plants in the examples.
2. Explain Nutrition in Plants to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Nutrition in Plants.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Nutrition in Plants using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Nutrition in Plants important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Nutrition in Plants
2. Practise Nutrition in Plants at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Nutrition in Plants

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
